opening.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Corvid Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Corvid Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning Corvid Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: I could not verify your identity, so please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Thank you, payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled during this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that; would you like me to connect you with our support team?

hint_retry.text: Could you please say the month as a word?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms the right party; answer a customer question first, and the ask that follows counts as the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first. The ask that follows is the second ask.

extra_rules.statement: To a third party, say nothing beyond the opening sentence and ask when the customer can be reached; never answer security questions or share account information, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: A callback must be on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive and later than now; a time today counts as outside the window.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the person offers a time today, treat it as outside the window and ask once for another time.

extra_rules.statement: After a condolence, ask nothing else and close as deceased.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Send the date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; read an all-numeric date as day, then month, then year; send four digits for phone_last4.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped retry does not count as a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining; a second refusal or a second such question closes the call as not_verified / declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every security question passes; state the product in words, the past_due amount and days_late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline; for a weekend or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: For a date after the deadline, say the latest date that can be recorded is the deadline and offer it; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: For a vague period, ask once for the exact day; if none is given, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: Accept a customer amount from the floor up to the full amount inclusive; below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal and uses one attempt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: When attempts are used up, stop, do not repeat a refused offer, and close as no_promise / refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: On illness, a death in the family or job loss: one sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer the support team (queue hardship); if declined, close as no_promise / hardship; if the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read back the product, amount and date and call create_promise only after a clear yes; re-check and re-read any change made at this step.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true; on a second failure, close as no_promise / service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: For a dispute (not mine, never had it, closed or paid off before), do not argue and take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: For a payment-plan request, do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: For a human request, ask once whether you can help first, before or after verification; transfer to general if they insist.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies before and after verification.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk: no_promise / refused after verification, not_verified / declined before.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Before identity is verified, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call ends the call as the last tool call; thank the customer and say goodbye before it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Thank the customer and say goodbye before it.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use the now variable, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not state a product_id format.

_source./bank: Corvid Bank calls customers who are 1 to 45 days late on one product.
_source./address: Address the customer as title plus last name.
_source./call_variables: `customer_id` | `c_91ab...` | Pass it to every tool call.
_source./bands/0/deadline_business_days: 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1
_source./bands/0/attempts: 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1
_source./bands/1/deadline_business_days: the latest promise date is now the **5th** business day after today
_source./bands/1/attempts: The number of persuasion attempts per band does not change.
_source./attempt_plan/0: Attempt 1: propose the full past-due amount (or the floor, if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week.
_source./attempt_plan/0/cap_at_deadline: If that day is after the deadline, propose the deadline.
_source./attempt_plan/1: Attempt 2, only in bands with 2 attempts: propose the floor amount on the deadline.
_source./weekday_words/next: "Next <weekday>" means that weekday in the following calendar week.
_source./weekday_words/this: "This <weekday>" means the one in the current week.
_source./identity/questions: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file
_source./identity/max_wrong: Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
_source./identity/swap_hint: `verify_identity` returns `hint: "day_month_swapped"`. Ask them to say the month as a word.
_source./callback/same_day: We no longer book same-day callbacks
_source./outcome_map/paid: take no promise, and close as `paid`
_source./product_types/credit_card/floor_field: The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card
_source./product_types/personal_loan/floor_field: `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan
_source./product_types/car_loan/floor_field: `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan
_source./account_fields/past_due: State the past-due amount (`past_due`) and how many days late it is (`days_late`).
